items.title: Jimmy Wormworth interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: somehow I got hooked up with Ronnie and Torrie Zito and I went to their house and brought my arrangements and they played them

ctx.x: At Proctor. Ronnie Zito went to UFA. We were best friends and it was like being on opposite sides of the country at that time as a teenager. But I started the music courses, took Rudiments of Music and History of Music and so forth. The rudiments teaches you key signatures and so forth, before theory where you learn harmony and all that. And I got this bug that I wanted to write some arrangements, like Gerry Mulligan’s quartet with no piano. And I did, just by sort in my head solfeggio. And somehow I got some…
Wow, in Little Falls, New York.
